title: Shotgun 650 Custom Bobber (Special Edition)
description: The Royal Enfield Shotgun 650 Custom Bobber (Special Edition) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Performance Cruiser segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 650cc engine generating 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 193 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
